'''Tarra''' is an Aiel in [[Aviendha]]'s visions of the future in the Glass columns ter'angreal in Rhuidean.

She will be a member of the Taardad clan. She dies in a raid against the [[Seanchan]] where they kill eight Seanchan soldiers.

== Trivia ==
* Tarra is named for Tara-Lynn Cosman, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
